login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to your timebank
login.registrationClosed: This community is not accepting new members at the moment.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a secure reset link.
forgotPassword.successSubtitle: If an account exists with that email address, a password reset link has been sent.
forgotPassword.helpText: The link may take a few minutes to arrive. Check your spam folder if you do not see it.
forgotPassword.rateLimited: Too many reset requests. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
forgotPassword.genericError: We could not send a reset link. Please try again.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
resetPassword.successSubtitle: You can now sign in with your new password.
resetPassword.invalidSubtitle: This password reset link is missing or no longer valid.
resetPassword.genericError: We could not reset your password. Please request a new link.

verifyEmail.loadingSubtitle: This should only take a moment.
verifyEmail.successSubtitle: Your email address has been verified.
verifyEmail.invalidSubtitle: This email verification link is missing or no longer valid.
verifyEmail.genericError: We could not verify your email. Please request a new link.
verifyEmail.resendHint: Enter your email address and we will send a new verification link.
verifyEmail.resendSent: If that address can be verified, a new email is on its way.
verifyEmail.resendFailed: We could not send the email just now. Please try again shortly.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Join your local timebank community
register.unsavedMessage: Everything you have typed so far will be lost.
register.termsAccepted: I agree to the platform terms and privacy notice, and I am 18 years of age or older.
register.successSubtitle: Your account was created and is waiting for verification.
register.successDefaultMessage: Registration successful. Please check your email before signing in.
register.noAnswerFromServer: We did not get a reply in time. Your account may already have been created — try signing in before registering again.
register.resendPrompt: Didn't get the email? Check your spam folder, or send it again.
register.resendSent: If that address can be verified, a new email is on its way.
register.resendFailed: We could not send the email just now. Please try again shortly.

errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.weakPassword: Password must be at least 12 characters.
errors.passwordUppercase: Password must contain at least one uppercase letter.
errors.passwordNumber: Password must contain at least one number.
errors.unableToSignIn: Unable to sign in. Please try again.
errors.unableToRegister: Unable to register. Please try again.
errors.validEmail: Please enter a valid email address
errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid international phone number.
errors.termsRequired: Please confirm you are 18 or older and accept the platform terms and privacy notice.

selectTenant.title: Select your timebank
selectTenant.subtitle: Choose the community you belong to
selectTenant.footer: Your chosen community is used for sign in, registration, and local content.
selectTenant.switchMessage: Your account is with {{current}}. To use {{next}} you need to sign in there, so you will be signed out of {{current}} now.
selectTenant.switchFailed: {{reason}} Nothing has changed — you are still signed in to {{current}}.

setup.title: Set up two-factor authentication
setup.reason: Two-factor authentication is required for your account before you can continue.
setup.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
setup.manual: Or enter this setup key manually:
setup.failed: Setup could not be completed. Retry, or return to sign in if your session has expired.
setup.recovery_help: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each code can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator.
setup.saved: I have saved my recovery codes

login.twofa_subtitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app
login.twofa_help: Lost access to your authenticator? Use a backup code to sign in, or contact your timebank coordinator for help recovering your account.
login.twofa_session_expired: Your two-factor authentication session expired. Please sign in again.
